
{{Otheruses|Shrines named "Wakamiya Hachiman Shrine" or "Wakamiya Hachiman-sha"|General description of Wakamiya Hachiman shrines|Wakamiya Hachiman-gū}}'''Wakamiya Hachiman Shrine''' (若宮八幡神社, Wakamiya Hachiman Jinja) or '''Wakamiya Hachiman-sha''' (若宮八幡社, Wakamiya Hachiman-sha) are [[Shinto shrine|Shrines]] found throughout [[Japan]].

== Major Wakamiya Hachiman Jinja ==
* [[Kagurazaka Wakamiya Hachiman Shrine]] – [[Tokyo]], [[:en:Shinjuku Ward|Shinjuku Ward]], [[Wakamiyachō (Shinjuku)|Wakamiyachō]]
* [[Wakamiya Hachiman Shrine (Saku, Nagano)]] – [[Nagano Prefecture]], [[Saku, Nagano|Saku]], [[Iwamurada]]
* [[Wakamiya Hachiman Shrine (Katō)]] – [[Hyōgo Prefecture]], [[Katō, Hyōgo|Katō]], Shintei
* [[Wakamiya Hachiman Shrine (Miyoshi, Hiroshima)]] – [[Hiroshima Prefecture]], [[Miyoshi, Hiroshima|Miyoshi]], Tōkaichi Minami
* [[Wakamiya Hachiman-gū (Bungotakada)|Wakamiya Hachiman Shrine (Bungotakada, Ōita)]] – [[Ōita Prefecture]], [[Bungotakada, Ōita|Bungotakada]], Takada
* [[Hiji Wakamiya Hachiman Shrine]] – Ōita Prefecture, [[:en:Hiji, Ōita|Hiji Town]], [[Hayami District, Ōita|Hayami District]]

== Major Wakamiya Hachiman Sha ==
* [[Wakamiyahachimansha]] – [[Saitama Prefecture]], [[Kazo, Saitama|Kazo]], Kitashimoshinden
* [[Wakamiya Hachiman Shrine|Wakamiya Hachiman-sha (Naka Ward, Nagoya)]] – [[Aichi Prefecture]], [[Nagoya]], [[Naka-ku, Nagoya|Naka Ward]], [[Sakae, Nagoya|Sakae]]
* [[Wakamiya Hachiman Sha (Toyokawa)]] – Aichi Prefecture, [[Toyokawa, Aichi|Toyokawa]], Inachō
* [[Wakamiya Hachiman-sha (Kitsuki, Ōita)]] – Ōita Prefecture, [[Kitsuki, Ōita|Kitsuki]], Miyaji
* [[Wakamiya Hachiman-sha (Ōita City)]] – Ōita Prefecture, [[:en:Ōita, Ōita|Ōita]], Uenomachi
